web.channel.feishu.setup.steps:
Create a custom enterprise app in the Feishu Open Platform
Enable bot capability and message permissions
Come back here and click Bind to scan + authorize
web.channel.wechat.setup.steps:
Click Add, then scan to log in to WeChat
Keep the local iLink host app online
web.channel.dingtalk.setup.steps:
Create an internal enterprise app in the DingTalk dev console
Copy the AppKey / AppSecret into the fields below
(Optional) register 3 card templates and paste their IDs — without them it still works as plain text; with them you get buttons + live status cards
web.channel.telegram.setup.steps:
Message @BotFather on Telegram and send /newbot
Name it, copy the Bot Token it gives you into the field below
After saving, DM the pairing code above to your bot

web.commands.title: Use from phone
web.commands.subtitle: Once a channel is bound, send commands from your bound IM app.
web.commands.tooltip.projects:
Effect: Lists projects available to control.
Usage: /projects
web.commands.tooltip.open:
Effect: Selects the project to work in.
Usage: /open <number|absolute path>
web.commands.tooltip.sessions:
Effect: Lists Codex conversations for the current project.
Usage: /sessions
web.commands.tooltip.new:
Effect: Starts a conversation and sends its first task.
Usage: /new <message>
web.commands.tooltip.approve:
Effect: Approves one pending Codex request.
Usage: /approve <approval id>
web.commands.tooltip.automode:
Effect: Toggles between Approve for me and Ask for approval.
Usage: /automode <true|false>
web.commands.tooltip.cancel:
Effect: Cancels the current Codex task or exits a picker.
Usage: /cancel
web.commands.tooltip.status:
Effect: Shows connection, authorization, and runtime status.
Usage: /status
web.commands.tooltip.current:
Effect: Shows the current project and conversation.
Usage: /current
web.commands.tooltip.use:
Effect: Switches to a conversation.
Usage: /use <number|id>
web.commands.tooltip.switch:
Effect: Switches to a conversation (alias for /use).
Usage: /switch <number|id>
web.commands.tooltip.tail:
Effect: Shows recent local conversation messages.
Usage: /tail [n]
web.commands.tooltip.file:
Effect: Sends a project file to the chat.
Usage: /file <path>
web.commands.tooltip.model:
Effect: Chooses the Codex model and reasoning effort.
Usage: /model
web.commands.tooltip.deny:
Effect: Denies one pending Codex request.
Usage: /deny <approval id>
